messages:
Maia: Heads-up — captured feedback from ClearHarbor onboarding call just now. Short list: 1) per-route cost export (CSV) — finance needs it for renewal, high risk, 2) console 'preview' mode to show new users what flows look like, 3) embedding freshness toggle. Attaching call notes link.
Jenna (customer): yep, thanks Maia. The lack of per-route export is the main blocker for our renewal review. Sent sample rows to the doc.
Tom: thanks — can you paste the top 2 asks + the tangible business impact so I can prioritize?
Maia: Top2: per-route export = urgent (finance/renewal flagged), preview mode = high impact for onboarding conversions. Embedding freshness = nice-to-have. ClearHarbor said renewal talk stalls without per-route numbers.
Alex: quick tech note — per-route export would be an aggregation endpoint + CSV job. Could be an async job to avoid hot paths. Rough: 1 sprint dev + QA if we reuse billing infra.
Ravi: agree with async job. Billing svc currently spikes if we add heavy aggregation per request. We should do a spike for scale patterns — estimate 3 weeks to deliver a production-safe implementation (including cache + job queue) if prioritized.
Tom: propose: spike this week to validate approach + perf. Maia, can you ask Jenna for sample volumes and finance acceptance criteria?
Maia: pinged Jenna in the doc and asked for volumes + a checklist for 'finance acceptance'. Added call notes: https://docs.google.com/example-clearharbor-notes
CS Bot: Meeting scheduled with ClearHarbor: 2026-02-05 10:00 PST — invites sent to @Tom @Alex @Maia.
Jenna (customer): added sample lines — about 4k routes, daily. Finance needs per-route and per-user daily totals in the CSV. Also attached console screenshot for preview request.
Tom: perfect. I'll sketch a PRD stub and slot it into sprint planning. Maia — how would you rank priority 1-3?
Maia: Rank: 1) per-route export, 2) preview mode, 3) embedding freshness toggle. Renewal is the deciding factor for #1.
Ravi: starting a spike ticket now and will include perf test harness. Tagging @eng-oncall for visibility.
Alex: +1 on async CSV job. For preview mode we can do a lightweight client-side mock to unblock onboarding quickly while console work finishes.
Maia: updating our tracker: https://redwood-inference.atlassian.com/browse/CS-???. Tom — can you own the PRD?
Tom: I'll own PRD and coordinate with Jenna. I'll add acceptance criteria: sample CSV format + perf SLA for generation. Target: Sprint 28.
Jenna (customer): appreciated — we'll be ready to review PRD. Finance expects a basic CSV within the demo. Thanks everyone.
Maia: thanks team. I'll follow up after the spike completes and sync in the meeting.
Tom: sounds good :thumbsup:
Ravi: noted. I'll post the spike results here when done.
Alex: thanks all :rocket:
